answer.rationale: Run a targeted referral-incentive experiment among established SMB accounts older than six months. This is the strongest verified option for sustainable qualified revenue, producing +7% qualified revenue with no retention harm. Do not answer the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered source showed a 12% decline in 30-day retention despite acquisition gains, directly conflicting with the long-term objective. Keep the referral response scoped because its demonstrated effect is concentrated in mature accounts and it may not resolve churn among newer price-sensitive customers.
